s.note: Mini lamb and rosemary pies under puff lids, eaten out of the heat.
s.how: Fry 1 diced onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add 500g lamb mince and brown for 8 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 250ml beef stock and 2 tsp chopped rosemary and simmer 12 minutes until thick, then cool 15 minutes. Line a 12-hole muffin tin with shortcrust rounds, fill, top with puff lids, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until deep golden. Serve with tomato sauce.

s.note: Crumbed chicken, ham, napoli sauce and melted cheese in soft rolls.
s.how: Slice 2 chicken breasts (about 600g) into 8 thin steaks and flatten. Crumb through flour, 2 beaten eggs and 200g breadcrumbs, and shallow fry in 1cm of oil for 3 minutes a side. Put on a tray, top each with 1 tbsp napoli sauce, half a slice of ham and a pinch of grated cheese, and grill for 5 minutes until melted and bubbling. Serve in 8 soft slider rolls.

m.note: Seared kangaroo fillet with roast sweet potato wedges and warm plum sauce
m.how: Rub 800g kangaroo fillet with 1 tsp ground pepperberry, garlic and oil. Roast 800g sweet potato wedges at 200C for 35 minutes. Sear the fillet hard to rare, rest 5 minutes and slice. Serve with warmed plum sauce.

w.n: Kings Canyon wattleseed and macadamia slice
w.note: Shortbread base, wattleseed caramel and macadamias, dark chocolate top.
w.how: Rub 150g cold butter into 225g plain flour and 60g sugar, press into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170C for 20 minutes. Stir a 395g tin of condensed milk, 60g butter, 100g brown sugar and 1 tbsp ground wattleseed in a pot over medium heat for 10 minutes until thick and caramel coloured, fold in 100g chopped macadamias and spread over the base. Cool, pour over 150g melted dark chocolate and chill 60 minutes before cutting into squares.

d.note: Raspberry and peach purée topped with sparkling rosé
d.how: Blend 150g raspberries with 1 ripe peach (or 200g tinned peaches, drained) and 1 tbsp sugar syrup until smooth, then strain. Spoon 30ml purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Top slowly with 150ml cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.
